98039894.s: A group of historic palaces in Abha, among the most prominent architectural landmarks in the region, built of natural stone with old corridors and majlis rooms. Abu Sarrah Palaces are among the most prominent historic architectural landmarks in Abha. They consist of three main palaces built by Sheikh Abu Sarrah, who was known for his wealth and influence in the region. It is said that he had more than 45 wives, which shows in the many wings and rooms inside the palaces. The palaces were built of natural stone and clay in the traditional Asiri style, and today house interior museums displaying old costumes and tools, along with shops selling souvenirs and handicrafts.

98039893.s: A cultural and artistic district in central Abha with workshops, art galleries and a theater, blending modern art with a heritage character. Al Muftaha Village (the Al Muftaha arts village) is in the center of Abha and is the oldest and best-known artistic community in the region, founded as a space to support local visual artists. The district has dozens of studios and open workshops for visitors, along with permanent exhibitions of artworks that combine authentic heritage character with contemporary artistic touches. The district is surrounded by stone walls and colored windows in the traditional Asiri style, and occasionally hosts cultural events and poetry evenings.

98039891.s: An adventure experience that starts in Al Soudah and ends in Rijal Alma along the Al Quroon trail, taking visitors to enchanting views and the stunning nature of this mountain route. The Al Quroon trail (Aqabat Al Quroon) is an ancient trade route linking the Al Soudah area with the heritage village of Rijal Alma, and is one of the best-known mountain hiking trails in Asir. The trail is relatively difficult at the start, where the path descends steeply among rocks before gradually becoming easier, and along the way there are remains of old stone buildings dating back to the days of ancient trade. The full trip takes about two to three hours on foot and ends at the historic village of Rijal Alma, making it an experience that combines adventure and history.
